papers.operation: Mean/std/min/max aggregators plus degree scalers; standard deviation explicitly sqrt(ReLU(meanX2-meanX squared)+epsilon); learned message/update functions with towers and graph/node readouts.
papers.proposed_difference: One cached raw-input weighted standard-deviation descriptor enters a native per-node hop Transformer; PNA recomputes moments of current learned messages inside message passing. This is a caching/placement adaptation, not cleared novelty.
papers.scope_limit: Statements of aggregator lower bound/moment expressivity were read, not proved. They do not show an actual missing-information error cause in complete PubMed.
papers.strongest_collision: Neighborhood moment information, mean insufficiency and standard-deviation aggregation are direct established prior. No new moment aggregation principle or finite-width expressive guarantee.
papers.title: Principal Neighbourhood Aggregation for Graph Nets
